w2:textbox.label: Apply Adaptive Design Based on Popup Size

1-1. Click the first button.
1-2. Adjust the size of the generated popup.
1-3. Verify that adaptive design is applied to the popup's source (src) screen based on the popup size. (adaptiveFrame: “true”)
(See the Script tab for detailed script.)

2-1. Click the second button.
2-2. Adjust the size of the generated popup.
2-3. Verify that adaptive design is not applied regardless of the popup size. (adaptiveFrame: “false”)
(See the Script tab for detailed script.)
